progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb3 and dwells most on Dk in Phrase 1. Phrase 18 (3:16.9) introduces Ab, centred on Fs. Phrase 40 (8:22.2) introduces A, centred on Bb. The line peaks at Bb4 (488.8 Hz) at 8:25.3. It closes on the tonic (Dk4 → Dk4 → Fs4 → Eb4 → Dk4 → Dk3).
